title: WPSS/2257/2016 of Ganesh Joshi Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 2257 of 2016
Ganesh Joshi Ö.Petitioner

Versus
State of Uttarakhand and another
 Ö.Respondents
Present: Mr. Sunil Upadhyaya, Advocate for the petitioner.
Ms. Prabha Naithani, Brief Holder for the State/respondents.

Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
 The petitioner was initially appointed on a
Class IV post on daily rated basis in the year 2001. In
May, 2012, the petitioner remained absent from duties
and when returned to join his duties, he was not given his
joining. Consequently, the petitioner was constrained to
file a writ petition before this Court being Writ Petition
(S/S) No. 521 of 2015, which was dismissed on merit by
this Court vide order dated 22.02.2016, though a liberty
was given to the petitioner to make a representation to the
authorities on a limited ground, which was that in case of
availability of work, the candidature of the petitioner for
fresh appointment be considered. The operative portion of
the order dated 22.02.2016 passed in Writ petition (S/S)
No. 521 of 2015 reads as under:-
ìSince the petitioner has no lien on the
said post, the relief he is seeking cannot be
granted to him. The writ petition stands
dismissed. However, the petitioner would be at
liberty to move a representation before the
Director of Sports (Kumaon Mandal), Haldwani
District-Nainital for his future engagement on
daily rated basis considering his past
experience in the department. In case it is done,
the same shall be duly considered within a
reasonable time.î

2
2. Thereafter, the petitioner moved a
representation, which has been rejected by the authorities
vide order dated 24.05.2016. Aggrieved, the petitioner has
filed the present writ petition challenging the order dated
24.05.2016.
3. A statement has been given before this Court by
Ms. Prabha Naithani, learned State Counsel, under
instructions from respondent no. 2, that petitionerís
representation has been rejected as the representation
was with the prayer for regularization in services and not
for granting fresh appointment, and as presently the work
is available the petitioner will be given appointment
subject to his moving a fresh representation for fresh
appointment on daily rated basis.
4. In view of the above statement made by learned
State Counsel, writ petition stands disposed, and the
petitioner can make a representation for fresh
appointment again on daily rated basis. In case it is done,
the same shall be considered by the respondent
authorities within a period of four weeks from the date of
receipt of such representation.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
Avneet/ 25.07.2017
